meta.name: memory-refresh
meta.description: Periodic memory maintenance — archive session files, convert recurring knowledge into summaries, update the memory index. Activate at end of a major phase (Discovery complete, sprint done) or when memory spans many sessions. For emergency context-window pressure mid-task, use memory-compact instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期归档会话并更新记忆索引，保持智能体知识条理清晰。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果智能体有大量跨会话记忆需要自动整理。
copy.tagline_en: Archive sessions and update memory index periodically to keep agent knowledge organized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent has extensive cross-session memory needing automatic upkeep.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会定期整理记忆：把会话记录归档，把重复出现的知识浓缩成摘要，并更新记忆索引。这样能让记忆保持精简、准确。
howto.when: 在完成一个大的工作阶段后（如完成调研、一个迭代结束），或者当记忆跨越很多次对话时触发。也可以定期每周或每个迭代触发一次。

say.text: 请整理一下我的记忆，把旧的会话归档并更新摘要。
say.note: Claude 会执行一次完整的记忆刷新流程。

say.text: 这个迭代结束了，帮我做一次记忆维护。
say.note: Claude 会归档当前迭代的会话并更新摘要。

say.text: 我的记忆有点乱，清理一下。
say.note: Claude 会检查并精简记忆索引。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will periodically perform memory maintenance: archive session files, convert recurring knowledge into summaries, and update the memory index. This keeps active memory minimal and high-signal.
howto.when_en: Activate after major phases (e.g., discovery complete, sprint done), when memory spans many sessions, or periodically (weekly per sprint). Not for mid-task context pressure; use memory-compact instead.

say_en.text: Please refresh my memory: archive old sessions and update summaries.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full memory refresh process.

say_en.text: This sprint is done, please do a memory maintenance.
say_en.note: Claude will archive session files and update summaries.

say_en.text: My memory is cluttered, clean it up.
say_en.note: Claude will check and compact the memory index.
